sections.heading: MINOR IN HUMAN RIGHTS STUDIES
lines: Completion of first-year requirements. Students must have an average of at least 60% in 3.0 principal courses, including a minimum grade of 60% in 0.5 course in one of the participating disciplines or a 0.5 credit in a 1000-level essay course, and no mark in any other principal course below 60%.
0.5 course from: Human Rights Studies 2900F/G, Human Rights Studies 2908F/G-2909F/G, Human Rights Studies 3908F/G-3909F/G.

2.5 courses from: Philosophy 2208E, Philosophy 3560F/G-3562F/G; Religious Studies 3451F/G or Social Justice and Peace Studies 3451F/G, Religious Studies 3452F/G or Social Justice and Peace Studies 3452F/G, Religious Studies 3360F/G or Social Justice and Peace Studies 3360F/G; Social Justice and Peace Studies 2301A/B, Social Justice and Peace Studies 2302A/B, Social Justice and Peace Studies 2303A/B, Social Justice and Peace Studies 3210F/G, Social Justice and Peace Studies 3211F/G, Social Justice and Peace Studies 3361F/G, Social Justice and Peace Studies 3365F/G, Social Justice and Peace Studies 3367F/G; English 2100F/G, English 2164E, English 2262F/G, English 2601E, English 3340F/G, English 3702E, English 3680F/G or Indigenous Studies 3880F/G; GSWS 2260 or GSWS 2270A/B, GSWS 2274F/G, GSWS 3163F/G, GSWS 3312F/G; History 3218E, History 3809F/G, History 3860E, History 3901-3903F/G, History 4204F/G, History 4220E, History 4502F/G, History 4503F/G, History 4504F/G, History 4861F/G, History 4860F/G, History 4896F/G; Political Science 3301F/G, Political Science 3361F/G, Political Science 4407F/G, Political Science 4480E, Political Science 3345E; Sociology 3371F/G.
Note: Other courses as approved by the Department may be substituted. Please consult the Department for more information.
Note: Students who have completed credits in a second-language may count 0.5 credits from those courses towards completion of these requirements.
